name: Light-Up Water Pistol
description: An electric water pistol that shoots continuous bursts at the squeeze of the trigger, with a light-up muzzle and a refillable water drum under the grip. Rechargeable by USB, and the box has the pistol, scope, drum and battery. About 25 × 27 × 10 cm. Water only. Not for use on faces or animals. Adult supervision for young children.

source.notes: All-in-one style, ¥9.80 for black/grey, blue, red. Black is the grey/black variant (listed 26×27×11 cm; blue and red 25×27×10 cm). Box contents from photos: USB charger, drum magazine, scope, 1 battery. Description says "about 25 × 27 × 10 cm" (grey is 1 cm bigger). Same 1688 listing (offer 1014190616395) as the other water-gun styles. 27K+ sold, 3,500+ praise, repurchase rate 27.8% (the page shows repurchase, not a return rate). China shipping ¥3/order (note only, not costed). Lithium battery: sea freight only. Realistic firearm-shaped children's toy: possible customs hold as imitation firearm, owner to confirm with clearing agent. No safety certification shown or claimed. Supplier photos are 800 px (soft once enlarged). Price per style from the seller style list; ₦2,186.81 shown for ¥9.80.
